basis: Human-reviewed V0.4.4-parser provisional evidence discovered by V0.4.5 exhaustive seed-audit-debt range backfill (2026-08-31..2026-10-09). Canonical unit remains a fact, not a PDF. T2 means an unnamed head-customer clue only and is not a named Tesla/Optimus relationship.

facts.fact_text: 公司披露2026年上半年具身智能与新兴科技硬件业务实现营业收入2.43亿元，同比增长537.64%；同时确认与海外头部机器人客户存在供应商及协同研发合作关系。
facts.component_domain: precision manufacturing / robot hardware components / assembly
facts.decision_rationale: Company IR record is affirmative and company-specific. The disclosed 2.43亿元 covers the combined embodied-intelligence and emerging-tech-hardware segment, so it supports commercial relevance but is not treated as pure robot revenue. The overseas head robot customer relationship is existing and affirmative, but unnamed; T2 is therefore only an unnamed-head-customer clue and not Tesla identification.

facts.fact_text: 公司具备较完整的机器人核心部件解决方案能力，可为工业移动机器人、协作机器人、工业机器人、人形机器人、泛服务机器人及仿生机器人提供显示、控制、驱动等多维度解决方案。
facts.component_domain: frameless torque motors / servo drives / reducers / robot control
facts.decision_rationale: Formal CNINFO-filed sponsor continuous-supervision report supports low-level company/product relevance only. It does not establish a named customer, order, shipment, revenue milestone, or Tesla/Optimus link.
